name: ClamAV GUI v1.0.7 — October 2026 Update
body:
## What's Changed?

### Added Languages
  - **🇨🇳 Mandarin Chinese** - Thanks @123qiu-jie!
### Added
- Antivirus page contexts to reduce prop drilling and replace nested `setX={setX}` props
  - History
  - Scan
  - Scheduler
  - Quarantine
- Additional ClamAV detection logging for debugging and troubleshooting
- Identifier on the about page
- Validations with **Zod** before importing settings
- Close button behavior settings - Resolves #23
  - Quit the application
  - Minimize to tray
- Amber theme of the app
- Optional macOS system exclusions setting for the TextToSpeech false-positive investigation.
  - Disabled by default.
  - Only shown on macOS.
  - Applies to regular and real-time scans.
### Changed
- Moved some UI settings into Appearance settings
  - Sidebar Collapsible state
  - Reduce Motion
- Changed Skeleton loader background to a muted color
### Improved
- **Error Handling & Translation Improvements**
  - Normalized backend errors using stable error codes.
  - Added localized backend error messages.
  - Added support for dynamic error parameters and pluralization.
  - Improved fallback handling for unknown errors and missing translations.
- Memoized shared contexts
  - Quarantine Count
  - Real-Time Scan
  - Themes
- Memoized functions inside contexts and on definitions updater state to reduce re-rendering
- **About Page**
  - Added Scroll approach on the info also and improved the UI
  - Changed the grid size a little bit and improved responsiveness
- **Overview Page** - Fixes #22
  - **Buttons** - Made the grid even more responsive by scaling down buttons
  - **Safety Indicator header** - Scaled down the header size and made it even more responsive
- Optimized Translations
- Lazy-loaded heavier UI sections to reduce initial loading work.
  - Scheduler table and header
  - Scheduler form
  - History table and header
  - Safety Indicator
  - About page content
  - Date and Range pickers
  - Clear date and clear range
  - Path form
  - Import and export settings
### Fixed
- macOS Homebrew ClamAV detection fallback - Fixes #16
  - `/opt/homebrew/bin/clamscan`
  - `/usr/local/bin/clamscan`
- The About Runtime Typescript error - Fixes #25
- Rose Icon not showing on an `Up To Icon` collapsible state
- Primary color of sidebar link icons
### Documentation
- Finished the usage guide
- Finished the translation guide
- Extended the installation guide to support Linux and macOS

**Full Changelog:** [`clamav-gui/CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/ArsenTech/clamav-gui/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

name: ClamAV GUI v1.0.5
body:
## What's Changed?

### Added
- Feature to log the GUI updater actions into the history
- New Clear History Options
  - Clear last 24 hours
  - Clear last 7 days
  - Clear last 30 days
  - Clear up to the date
- Sidebar collapsible behavior setting
  - Up to Icon (Default)
  - Offcanvas Window
### Changed
- Converted each data table cell into a reusable component
- Replaced alert boxes from `Dialog` and `Drawer` components with `AlertDialog` component from ShadCN UI
### Improved
- **Caching** - Cached the app name with app version into the `getAppDetails()` function
- **The Sidebar Design** - Only icons will show if it's collapsed
- Organized Headers and cells of data tables
- Dropdown Menu Destructive design
### Fixed
- The History Details action greying out bug
- The bug of showing nothing on the Device Details stat after caching
- **The build workflow bug** - Fixed the Linux ARM64 part
- **The Date fetch error** - Added a try-catch inside `formatDate()`
- **The Scan Lifecycle Bug** - Rewrote the Scan Logic for stability
- **The scan state desynchronization bug** - Fixes #11, Used the minimal stable fix
### i18n
- Completed translations for 🇺🇸 English, 🇦🇲 Armenian, 🇷🇺 Russian
- Prepared missing keys for community contributions
